title: Iterative FFT Stage Loop Visualizer
description: A live in-place iterative FFT on an 8-element array, stepped one stage at a time, with pairing arcs and a readout of stage, span, and butterfly count.
creator: Real-Time DSP on a $5 Microcontroller
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Digital Signal Processing
FFT
Algorithms

learningObjectives: Examine the iterative stage loop on a concrete array
Compare doubling span against constant butterfly count
Explain why bit-reversal must precede the stage loop

controls.label: Apply permutation
controls.purpose: Bit-reverse the array before the stage loop

controls.label: Run next stage
controls.purpose: Execute one pass of the outer loop in place

assumptions: Real-valued input with zero imaginary parts
limitations: Shows one worked example; fixed-point rounding and overflow behavior are covered in later chapters

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Stage-by-stage stepping with a verifiable end state
keyQuestions: What changes between stages and what stays fixed?
Why must the permutation happen before the loop?
commonMisconceptions: That later stages do more work than earlier ones
That the FFT and DFT give different answers
assessmentOpportunities: Compute stage count and total butterflies for N = 1024
